title: Semantic Control Hardening v1
goal: Harden the generic semantic-control substrate independently of the Local EXTRACT scientific task by proving historical decision replay, temporal/supersession/contradiction behavior, stale-state and version-skew failure isolation, bounded ontology-slice retrieval, generalized request-only EvidenceRequirement semantics, end-to-end DecisionEvaluation audit chains, deterministic scale behavior, and a consumer-side opaque EXTRACT integration socket. This task must improve the semantic-control infrastructure without defining, steering, implementing, or mutating EXTRACT.
acceptance_criteria: The task consumes the completed prototype and PRE_EXTRACT_INTEGRATION_PASS checkpoints but does not mutate workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1.
The task does not modify research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1, its scientific hypotheses, benchmarks, prompts, retrieval/generation methods, Qwen/Codex choices, routes, or acceptance criteria.
Historical decision replay reproduces the exact prior ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN result from pinned knowledge, policy, candidate, precondition, and decision identities even when current state differs.
Temporal semantics preserve superseded records, contradictions, and open-world unknowns without destructive overwrite or global truth collapse.
Stale or version-skewed policy/task/receipt/source state fails closed for any action that requires current authority context.
OntologySliceV1 retrieval is deterministic, bounded, provenance-bearing, and returns only schema/entity/relation context relevant to the frozen query/action scenarios.

EvidenceRequirementV1 remains REQUEST_ONLY and is derived from durable evidence needs such as missing facet, source level, verification state, contradiction, staleness, and benchmark-calibrated insufficiency; raw model confidence alone cannot create an escalation.

DecisionEvaluation audit chains bind candidate action, semantic/knowledge checkpoint, exact authority artifact/version, precondition evidence, decision reasons, and optional later receipt identity without fabricating execution.

Adversarial tests cover stale ALLOW, policy downgrade, fake epistemic permission, incorrect receipt binding, source blob drift, repository disagreement, missing authority, and corrupt projection; all authority-sensitive cases fail closed with zero authorization escapes.

Synthetic scale benchmarks exercise deterministic semantic state at 1k, 10k, and 100k observations for manifest rebuild, bounded slicing, provenance traversal, temporal replay, and decision lookup; results are empirical with no retroactive threshold.

The consumer-side EXTRACT socket is versioned and opaque: it defines how a future accepted external output descriptor is registered and adapted into SemanticObservationV1, but does not define the external EXTRACT payload schema itself.
No RDF/Neo4j/persistent KG service or new third-party runtime dependency is introduced by default; backend changes require separate evidence.
No production database/schema/policy/EXTRACT/VERIFY/Lambda/executor routing mutation occurs in this task.
Final verdict is HARDENING_PASS, REVISE, or REJECT. HARDENING_PASS may be consumed by the blocked integration task later but does not itself authorize production promotion.
constraints: Do not mutate tasks/active/research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1.json or any EXTRACT-owned benchmark/result.
Do not mutate tasks/active/workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1.json; read it only as dependency state.
Do not modify src/research_engine/**, sql/**, migrations, pyproject/dependencies, .github workflows, production routing, model configuration, or runtime controllers.
Do not modify workspace-control workflows, procedures, policies, schemas, architecture authority files, Heartbeat implementation, or any task other than this hardening capsule/handoff.
Use deterministic typed records and in-memory indexes only. No graph database or persistent semantic service.
No external network, model inference, Lambda/GPU execution, autonomous experiment launch, or executor invocation.
Semantic inference, learned/model output, graph edges, EvidenceRequirement, OntologySlice, CandidateAction, or hardening benchmark results never create authority.
Unknown is not false; contradictory assertions coexist; supersession preserves history; authority revisions remain separate, explicit, and versioned.
Synthetic scale fixtures must be generated deterministically from frozen seeds/parameters and must never be presented as scientific evidence.
The EXTRACT socket must remain opaque until the owning EXTRACT task independently earns an accepted output contract.
Cross-chat coordination uses durable Git/task capsules and exact SHAs. Heartbeat is liveness/ownership only.
